title: Seven Samurai
description:
A motley assortment of masterless Samurai bands together
to defend a poor village from bandits. There are so many facets
to this film’s greatness, here are shichi: 1.The way each Samurai’s
introduced, making us root for every one. 2.Toshiro Mifune’s petulant,
snorting charisma. 3. The way the film moves, like a fairground
ride. 4.Collectivism! 5.The surprise of a coy, sun-dappled, moving
romance 6. A climactic, thrilling rain-slicked battle for the ages. 7.
The high feeling, that you have seen an utter, stone-cold masterpiece...
in a cinema!
